issues_detected.description: No errata or change descriptions exist despite a five-release history: version_access.versions_available lists the releases and their Dataverse versions but describes no changes between them, errata is absent, and known_limitations mentions only the embargo. A reader cannot tell what June 2026 changed relative to October 2025.
issues_detected.recommendation: Add per-release change descriptions (or errata entries) to version_access, at minimum for the transition the is_new_version_of chain asserts.

issues_detected.description: Per-release version numbers are non-monotonic across the series (March 2025 = 1.4, June 2025 = 2.1, October 2025 = 2.1, June 2026 = 2.0). The record states the versions accurately and sets its own top-level version to 2.0, but does not explain that each release is a separate Dataverse dataset with its own version counter.
issues_detected.recommendation: Add a sentence to version_access explaining that versions are per-Dataverse-dataset, so 2.0 (June 2026) does not follow 2.1 (October 2025) on one counter.

issues_detected.description: external_resources and raw_sources name archival repositories (MassIVE, Sequence Read Archive via an NCBI BioProject, Figshare) without any accession numbers or URLs, so none of the external deposits is resolvable from the record.
issues_detected.recommendation: Add MassIVE (MSV...), BioProject (PRJNA...) and Figshare identifiers or URLs to each archival external_resources entry.

issues_detected.description: The citation author list contains 'Ballllosero Navarro F' (quadruple l, likely a source transcription artifact) and keywords retain the source term 'mass spectroscopy' where the technique is mass spectrometry.

issues_detected.description: preprocessing_strategies, labeling_strategies and machine_annotation_tools describe the MuSIC cell-map construction and annotation pipeline (node2vec, DenseNet-121, HiDeF, GPT-4 via GSAI), but known_limitations states the release 'does not contain predicted cell maps'. The fields document a declared method whose outputs are not in the described holdings; source_caveats acknowledges the shared-pipeline sourcing.
issues_detected.recommendation: Keep the pipeline documentation with its caveat; when cell maps are released, attach these strategies to the released files.

issues_detected.description: variables and anomalies are absent for a multimodal dataset whose file_collections include interaction tables, perturbation atlases and image archives, and cleaning_strategies says QC was ongoing 'at the time of the CM4AI preprint' without stating outcomes or criteria.
issues_detected.recommendation: Document variables for the principal tables (interaction records, perturbation atlas fields, image channel definitions) and record QC outcomes or known anomalies.

issues_detected.description: created_on 2025-02-27 predates the June 2026 release by sixteen months; the record itself caveats that this Dataverse 'Data Creation Date' is carried unchanged across four release records and is unlikely to be specific to this release's content.
issues_detected.recommendation: No change to the record; the caveat is the correct treatment. Upstream, the Dataverse record should carry a release-specific creation date.

issues_detected.description: distribution_formats gives the Dataverse dataset landing page as the access URL with prose describing direct download and the Data Access API, but no per-file download_url; file sizes are carried as display strings ('3.8 GB') inside descriptions rather than as byte counts, which the record explains (the bundle states no exact byte values).

sub_elements.quality_note: Typed, specific limitations with impact and mitigation statements.

sub_elements.name: Biases Categorized Using Standard Taxonomy

sub_elements.quality_note: Bias is enum-categorized and tied to affected subsets; selection bias from the targeted protein panel remains only under sampling_strategies and no AIO mapping is given.

strengths: Coherent identity block: top-level id, doi, version and citation all name the same June 2026 release (10.18130/V3/HIGT4C, V2.0), with the full release lineage in typed related_datasets entries

Internally consistent non-human-subjects ethics posture with explicit negative declarations: involves_human_subjects=false, is_deidentified rationale, hipaa_compliant=not_applicable, and sensitive_elements/confidential_elements/content_warnings all explicitly false with reasons
Composition is modeled structurally: seven condition subsets flagged is_subpopulation, a subpopulations entry with per-condition modality coverage, and ontology-tagged instances
Checksummed per-file inventory (ten files with md5, size, date, collection_type) plus provenance from generating labs through raw-data repositories to RO-Crate/FAIRSCAPE-packaged releases

Source conflicts (imaged-protein counts, project-level aggregates, repeated creation date, affiliation discrepancy) are surfaced in source_caveats with declared source-priority reasoning rather than silently collapsed
weaknesses: No change descriptions or errata anywhere despite a five-release history — the largest single gap
No variable-level metadata for any modality, and payload formats inside the ZIP archives are never named
Archival deposits (MassIVE, SRA/BioProject, Figshare) are named without accession numbers or URLs, so they are not resolvable from the record
No data-level anomalies or QC outcomes; cleaning_strategies reports QC only as ongoing at preprint time
Software tools carry no version numbers, and grant numbers live in funders notes rather than structured slots
recommendations: Add change descriptions per release (and errata where applicable) to version_access, and explain the per-Dataverse-dataset version counters
Add accession numbers or URLs for the MassIVE, SRA/BioProject and Figshare deposits in external_resources and raw_sources
Add variables for the principal data tables (interaction records, perturbation atlas fields, image channel definitions) and name the payload formats per file collection
Record QC outcomes or known anomalies for the released streams, and versions for the named software tools
Move grant numbers from funders notes into structured grant slots so they are machine-extractable
